changes.summary: excludeShards: keep a route request off shards that already failed it
The Bun gateway retries a request whose upstream cannot be reached on another shard, reports each failed upstream, and can bound how long an upstream takes to send its headers
changes.detail: Only methods safe to repeat (GET, HEAD, OPTIONS) are retried, once by default, on a fresh route that excludes the shards already tried. onUpstreamFailure lets a caller stop routing to a dead shard before its next health check. upstreamHeadersTimeoutMs answers 504 and never retries, so slow work never runs twice.

changes.summary: preserveHost: send the client's Host to the upstream so apps behind the gateway see their public name
Pass compressed responses through the Bun gateway as the app encoded them

changes.detail: Set publicProtocol from trusted deployment settings when ingress terminates TLS. Forged client forwarding headers remain ignored.
changes.summary: Preserve the configured public HTTPS protocol through HTTP and WebSocket gateways behind TLS termination
